description.narrative: The Academy for Ocean Innovation aims at supporting youth to have access to high-level mentors coming from top-notch universities, labs, and start-ups, in order to catalyse their ocean-related careers. The Academy will work towards shaping the next Ocean Generation of young professionals by providing learning experiences, mentoring, and high-level training that will support the development of technological solutions for the main ocean challenges. The Academy will as well, leverage established frameworks such as the Ocean Literacy with All (OLWA) officially-endorsed Decade programme, through advancing international collaborations and networks. The Ph.D. grantee will contribute to OLWA Components 1 (Development of baseline assessment and indicators) and 2 (Facilitate international OL research), aiming to establish a comprehensive global OL research program to address current knowledge gaps.
